title: Metal Isn't Colder Than Wood
pause_note: Short format v3: 20-30 s, claim first, loop ending

beats: Leave both in one room, and they reach the same temperature.
But your hand is warmer, about thirty-four degrees Celsius.
Aluminium conducts heat over a thousand times better than wood.
So your skin cools more, and faster, on the metal.
That fast cooling is what you feel as cold.
